name: MOTS-c
aliases: Mitochondrial ORF of the 12S rRNA type-c
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: MOTS-c (MS) is a linear synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 4 pack sizes: 10 mg, 15 mg, 20 mg, 40 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is MOTS-c tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each lot of MOTS-c is analysed by HPLC for purity and by mass spectrometry for identity. The lot-specific certificate of analysis reports the measured purity, retention time, molecular mass and appearance. Catalogue purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC).

faq.question: How should MOTS-c be stored?
faq.answer: Store the lyophilized powder at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture. After reconstitution, keep the solution at 2-8 °C and use it within the period stated in the lot certificate of analysis. Avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles. This product is for laboratory research use only.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for MOTS-c?
faq.answer: MOTS-c is available in 4 configurations: 10 mg, 15 mg, 20 mg, 40 mg. Each kit contains 10 vials. Minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Volume pricing applies to 10-49 kits and 50+ kits.
